primary_task: Write Go code (Plugin Framework) for a Terraform provider resource and data source with CRUD, schema, import, waiters and acceptance tests.

requirements.name: Go toolchain
requirements.evidence: Go code blocks throughout; `go generate ./...`; `go.mod` inspection
requirements.basis: bash: install packages from the open registries (... apt from Ubuntu, go modules ...)

requirements.name: Terraform CLI (to execute acceptance tests)
requirements.evidence: Testing: "Every resource ships with, at minimum: `_basic` ... `_disappears`"; `resource.ParallelTest`
requirements.basis: Terraform binary hosts are not on the allow-list; tests are required to be written, running them is delegated to the `run-acceptance-tests` skill.

requirements.name: tfplugindocs
requirements.evidence: "generate Registry documentation with `tfplugindocs` (`go generate ./...` where wired up)"

requirements.name: live cloud API credentials for acceptance runs
requirements.basis: Not stated; the example provider is fictional and credentials are not part of writing the code.

requirements.name: existing provider repository (go.mod, internal/provider)
requirements.evidence: "To tell which mode an existing provider is in, check `go.mod`"; File Structure `internal/provider/`
requirements.basis: Supplied via the working directory or GitHub (github connector, gh via the proxy); the manifest does not say which repo.

notes: I took the deliverable as the implementation plus test and doc source. If executing the acceptance tests and generating docs with a Terraform binary were mandatory, the Terraform download and cloud credentials would probably give BLOCKED.
